subject: Co-sell: Marketplace demo windowing & ops runbook alignment
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@cloudstride.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: matt.dobson@aws-partner.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Introduction + co-sell demo — aligning marketplace narrative

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick connect last week. CloudStride is excited to join Redwood and AWS for a joint marketplace demo focused on a proof-of-concept for Acme Retail (their evaluation is next quarter). Matt from AWS looped me in. Our ask: a 45–60 minute joint demo that walks through Redwood Dedicated + our SI integration patterns and the marketplace procurement flow.

High-level objectives:
- Show a live inference run with the Acme dataset (sanitized)
- Walk through provisioning via AWS Marketplace + contract/commit flow
- Cover typical ops runbook for scaling and fallback (what to do when Dedicated capacity hits limits)

We can be flexible on timing but prefer US mornings. Proposed windows:
- Tue Jul 20: 09:30–10:30 PT
- Wed Jul 21: 10:00–11:00 PT

Let me know what works and who from Redwood should be on the call (technical lead + partner lead ideally). I can share a short runbook ahead of time.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Head of Alliances, CloudStride
priya@cloudstride.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: draft-agenda.md (text stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@cloudstride.io>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, matt.dobson@aws-partner.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction + co-sell demo — aligning marketplace narrative

Hi Priya — great to meet you (virtually).

Thanks for the clear objectives. We'll plan to have:
- Aditya (Partner Lead) to handle marketplace/procurement flow
- Vanessa (Solutions) to run the demo with our Dedicated + caching config
- Me to own the roll-forward and any commercial asks during the session

The Tue Jul 20 slot at 09:30 PT is possible for us, but Vanessa has a standing all-hands 10:00–10:30 PT that day; we can do 09:15–10:15 PT as a buffer if that helps. If you want 60 minutes to hit the runbook + Q&A, let's take 09:15 start.

I also recommend we circulate a short runbook and the marketplace checklist ahead of the call (2–3 bullets each) — that helps procurement folks follow along. Aditya — can you share the marketplace checklist and confirm if AWS wants to present the procurement steps or hand off to me? Matt — any preference?

I'll tentatively hold 09:15–10:15 PT on Tue for the Redwood side and will send an invite once we lock.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Hannah.Schmitt@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@cloudstride.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, matt.dobson@aws-partner.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction + co-sell demo — aligning marketplace narrative

Hi Hannah — thanks, that buffer is helpful. Quick update: our technical lead (Sanjay) just informed me he’s on a customer escalation on Tue morning and would prefer Wed Jul 21. He can do 10:00–11:00 PT as originally suggested.

If Redwood can pivot to Wed 10:00 PT, that would be ideal — otherwise we can proceed with Tue and he will join for the second half.

We'd also like the runbook to include:
- Expected token throughput at three load tiers
- Quick fallback steps (pin model variant, route to hosted)
- Who owns audit logs / support contact for marketplace customers

I can attach our sanitized dataset pointer and a one-pager for Acme if helpful.

- Priya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@cloudstride.io>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, matt.dobson@aws-partner.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Introduction + co-sell demo — aligning marketplace narrative

Hi team — Wed Jul 21 at 10:00 PT works for Redwood and AWS (Matt confirmed offline). Swapping the slot is fine — thanks for flagging Sanjay's conflict.

I'm attaching a lightweight runbook (co-sell-runbook_v1.pdf) that covers the marketplace checklist and the three-tier throughput table we discussed. Vanessa — can you confirm you can demo from a Dedicated instance with KV prefix caching enabled? That will let us show the ops knob in real time.

Also adding the HubSpot deal link so CS/procurement can track post-demo actions.

Cheers,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

--
Attachment: co-sell-runbook_v1.pdf (stub)
Related: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/4592

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@cloudstride.io>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: matt.dobson@aws-partner.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Wed Jul 21 10:00 PT — joint demo invite

Hi all — calendar invite sent for Wed Jul 21, 10:00–11:00 PT (demo-invite.ics).

Agenda (45 mins + 15 mins buffer):
1) Introductions & success criteria (5 mins)
2) Live demo: Dedicated + CloudStride integration (25 mins)
3) Marketplace procurement walkthrough (10 mins)
4) Ops runbook & Q&A (15 mins)

Priya — please share the sanitized dataset pointer and Sanjay's dial-in. I'll prepare the Dedicated instance snapshot and enable KV caching before the demo. Aditya — I'll hand over procurement walk-through to you for the HubSpot/marketplace part.

See you Wednesday,
Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

--
Attachments: demo-invite.ics (calendar stub), co-sell-runbook_v1.pdf (as referenced)
